subject.title: fix(xai): gate server-side tools to xAI models only

question: Should xAI-billed `code_execution` and `x_search` be hidden unless the active model provider is `xai`, or should OpenClaw preserve an explicit cross-provider opt-in path?
rationale: The safer default matches the plugin fail-closed guidance, but it intentionally changes existing credential-based tool availability for users who may combine non-xAI models with xAI-billed tools.

options.title: Fail closed by default
options.body: Require `activeModel.provider === "xai"` for xAI-billed tools and document cross-provider use as unsupported unless a future explicit opt-in is added.

options.title: Add explicit cross-provider opt-in
options.body: Keep the safety gate but add a deliberate config or plugin-policy path for users who intentionally want non-xAI models to call xAI-billed tools.

options.title: Preserve credential-based exposure
options.body: Reject the gate and rely on existing tool policy or docs, accepting the ongoing cross-provider billing risk.

recommendation.title: Fail closed by default
recommendation.body: Require `activeModel.provider === "xai"` for xAI-billed tools and document cross-provider use as unsupported unless a future explicit opt-in is added.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the strongest recent owner signal for the active-model plugin context and the current xAI factory/docs boundary touched by the decision.
